Private Offer Flow
Version 19Azure: multi-plan private offer, existing plan (draft for review)
What changed (27)
  1. New Confirm before plans are cleared. Changing the seller account or plan type with plans added now asks first, instead of silently removing them.
  2. Changed Configure price leads with pricing. Price type, prices and metering come first; read-only plan details sit in a collapsed section. Price type is editable here.
  3. New Bulk discount. Set one discount for all plans in Add offers/plans, or apply a plan\u2019s discount to the other discounted plans.
  4. Changed Price summary in the table. Each configured plan shows its price or discount; the always-Draft Status column is removed.
  5. New Unsaved-changes guard and Undo. Closing Configure price with edits asks first; deleting plans offers Undo in the toast.
  6. Changed New Plan clarity. The Plan field is renamed to Copy settings from an existing plan, with clearer hints; Auto Activation explains its effect; the dead xls buttons are removed.
  7. Changed Lightning modal pattern (Azure). The two new dialogs follow the Lightning modal structure: small and large sizes, title as the only h1, body headings from h2, a directional footer (Cancel left, action right), focus lands on the title, Esc closes and returns focus to the opener, and the large one fills the screen on phones.
  8. Changed Plan type first (Azure). Plan Type moves from Offer Pricing to Offer Setup. Existing plan shows a single Product Type; new plan shows a multi-select.
  9. New Add offers/plans (Azure). A picker groups plans by offer with a live "n of 10" counter, search, and a price type choice, as in Partner Center. Plans already added show as Added.
  10. New Product offers table (Azure). Offer name, plan name, offer type, price type, price and status per row, with row select and Delete offers/plans.
  11. New Configure price dialog (Azure). One larger dialog per plan with read-only duration, billing frequency and auto activation, editable pricing and metering dimensions.
  12. Changed Each plan must be configured. Next and Submit list every plan that still needs a price.
  13. Assumed Assumed (Azure). Professional services need a new plan, new plan keeps one plan at a time, plan names and prices are sample data, and xls export/import is shown but inactive.
  14. New Email check. Invalid addresses are rejected on agent, customer and recipient fields. Recipient lists block duplicates.
  15. New Past dates blocked. Expiration, accept-by, invoice dates and other dates can’t be in the past.
  16. Changed Live checks. Date conflicts, invoice dates and schedule totals flag when a related field changes or when you leave the field, not only on Next.
  17. Changed Error summary. Next and Submit show a summary at the top of the step with a link to every field. It stays until each field is fixed. The disappearing error toast is gone.
  18. Changed Dialog focus. Preview and Discard take focus, trap Tab, close on Esc and return focus to the button that opened them.
  19. Changed Keyboard dropdowns. Dropdowns keep focus, open with arrow keys and return focus when you choose or press Esc.
  20. Changed 44px targets. On phones and touch screens buttons, inputs, nav rows and radio rows are at least 44px tall.
  21. Changed Mobile footer. Cancel and Back move to the header, Preview becomes an icon and the footer stays one row (62px).
  22. Changed Real upload. Uploads open the file picker, check type, size, count and duplicates, show progress and list errors per file. Success messages stay six seconds and can be closed.
  23. Changed Read-only fields. Locked values show a lock icon and a muted box.
  24. Changed No repeated titles. Section titles that repeated the field label are removed.
  25. New Required legend. Each step explains the asterisk.
  26. New Replacement agreement. Replacement offers choose the agreement they replace. Options are sample data.
  27. Assumed Assumed tags. Layouts built without a recording are tagged: AWS SaaS and AMI payment schedule, CPPO markup options, Azure existing plan pricing.

Not changed on purpose: Save as Draft stays on step 5 only. The info icons stay as separate Tab stops so keyboard users can open tips.
